description: Return the main ingredients, timings, servings and original source for one recipe found by find_recipes_from_ingredients. Pass the cook’s ingredients again to get the missing list for this recipe specifically. The FULL ingredient list and the written method are not returned: those are what a free FridgeToForks account gives a cook, along with the method rewritten for the equipment they own.

ingredients.description: Optional. What the cook has, to compute what is missing.

recipe_id.description: The recipe_id from a find_recipes_from_ingredients result.

name: get_recipe_details
title: Get one recipe’s ingredients and timings
